scope.description: An optional lighting direction for a user-requested multi-figure scene with a specified directional light source. Let one broad diagonal path of light cross the group, catching only the body and fabric planes turned toward it; keep the spaces between those highlights in deep colored shadow. The light organizes movement and volume but does not introduce a new event, source, costume, or narrative.
limitations: Activate only for a user-requested multi-figure scene with a specified directional light source.
Preserve all requested people, identities, poses, clothing, props, actions, and the stated source and direction of light.
Illuminate only planes plausibly facing the specified light; do not change anatomy or invent a second source to brighten shadow areas.
Keep highlights warm but retain deep colored shadows and intermediate tones; do not wash out skin, cloth, or materials.
Do not add mythological, religious, winged, courtly, or allegorical figures unless the user requests them.
Do not copy the composition, poses, lighting layout, or figures of a named Rubens work.

rules.applies_when: The user specifies a directional light source in a multi-figure scene.
rules.instruction: Carry the specified light as one broad diagonal path across part of the group; let it touch selected faces, limbs, or fabric planes according to their orientation while leaving intervening areas in shadow.
rules.observable: The viewer can trace one dominant diagonal sequence of lit planes, and some requested forms remain in colored shadow.
rules.reject_when: Light becomes a uniform wash, several competing beams appear, or illumination contradicts the user's source direction.
rules.avoid: unrequested spotlight, glowing outline, and copied beam placement

rules.applies_when: The specified light crosses moving or overlapping figures.
rules.instruction: Place warm highlights only on planes facing the requested source; retain deep, colored shadow in overlaps and on turned-away surfaces so the bodies do not read as evenly lit.
rules.observable: The highlighted areas form broken, selective patches across the group rather than complete pale figures or continuous rim light.
rules.reject_when: Skin, clothing, and props lose their local colors, or shadows flatten into featureless black.
rules.avoid: full-figure spotlight, gray monochrome shadows, and blown highlights

rules.applies_when: The user requests interacting or overlapping figures.
rules.instruction: Let the selective highlights move across the requested figures in a readable diagonal order, preserving each pose and keeping the main action clear within the group.
rules.observable: Light reinforces the requested action and overlap; it does not turn the group into anonymous fragments.
rules.reject_when: The light sequence obscures a face, limb relation, prop, or identity cue.
rules.avoid: added figures, theatrical smoke, and narrative symbols

joint_checks.instruction: Let the requested directional source cross the group in one diagonal sweep, picking out selected planes so light clarifies the existing poses while shadows retain color and volume.
joint_checks.observable: The lighting has a clear source and path; highlighted planes connect across the group, yet every person's pose and local color remain legible.
